description.value: The Renfrew Pub is a waterfront pub and restaurant sitting next to the dock in Port Renfrew, with a cathedral-ceilinged great room, a 10-tap draught system, and sprawling wrap-around patios offering panoramic views of the bay and bluffs. It operates as a first-come-first-served establishment and is part of the Wild Renfrew complex, making it the natural social hub for visitors arriving at the western end of the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail and West Coast Trail corridor. The relaxed, dog-friendly front patio and allergy-adaptable menu add to its appeal as an end-of-day stop for touring cyclists.
